selection: all 23 stations in the author-published roster before retrieving daily time series; do not replace stations based on outcomes
selection_caveat: 23 were selected by original authors for >=5 years total data; these are not a representative random sample
prior_contact: search station numbers and geography in named local source and evaluation inventories; no ID matches found in initial text search, geographic and network independence not established
quality: published tw_obs removed periods after manual hourly and spot checks; study accepted daily means with >=20 hourly values, actual day-specific counts and flags unavailable; no 24-hour completeness claim, possible air-temperature-dependent selection
qualification: at least four full Gregorian calendar years with one finite, non-conflicting tw_obs per day; continuous 24h per day is unverified. Test only this weaker reference as exploratory, never override strict quality criterion
analysis: source models frozen, same masks and scoring for D2 and calibrated stochastic; only if temporal, source-model, support and reference availability permit; consider shared watershed/climate dependence
climate: BC station observations may share climatic forcing and hydrologic networks with previously used US stations; separation of station labels does not establish independence
coordinates: rounded 0.01 degree as published article table 1, used only with clear precision caveat for meteorological forcing
status: unregistered prospective local analysis plan; published study has existing results; no masked-recovery outcomes inspected
